checkRuns.command: grep -rl '#lib' src | xargs sed -i "s/#lib\//\$lib\//; s/'#lib'/'\$lib'/"; sed -i "s#\$lib/books.server#\$lib/books.server#" -r src/routes/+page.server.ts; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -12; cat tsconfig.json

grep -rl '\$lib' src | xargs sed -i -E "s#\\\$lib/books\.server'#\#lib/books.server.js'#; s#\\\$lib/favorites\.svelte'#\#lib/favorites.svelte.js'#; s#\\\$lib/validate'#\#lib/validate.js'#"
grep -rn "lib/" src | grep import; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -12

docs.source: https://svelte.dev/llms.txt and the files it links
